summary: Scinai Immunotherapeutics Ltd. filed Form 6-K containing audited financial statements of its newly acquired subsidiary, Scinai Biopharma Services Ltd. (formerly Recipharm Israel Ltd.), and unaudited pro forma financial information for the acquisition completed on February 17, 2026. No deal terms, price, or premium are disclosed in this filing; it is a post-closing accounting compliance filing. The board previously approved and completed the acquisition. The filing serves to update the SEC and incorporate these financials into the registrant's registration statements. This is a routine reporting requirement, not a new special-situations event. What to watch: integration updates and subsequent operational performance of the CDMO business.
